g.text: M7: fixed-delay correlation versus full-band Table 5; no lag fitting
Limited inlet band with SVV; scope-qualified descriptive comparison. No full-band fidelity or 2% accuracy verdict.
Linear temporal interpolation at exact Delta x/Ubar. Earlier-inlet extension is secondary. Full-window covariance ratios need not stay in [-1,1]; no values clipped.
